title: Xavi is a legend
text: I don't normally write reviews but Xavi was so good I had to. He spent extra time answering our questions, pointed out things we never would have found, and just made the whole thing feel special. Best guide in Barcelona.
author: N8080PIemmag

title: An absolute MUST in Barcelona.
text: The visit was exceptional. We visited Parc Güell with the family, and Xavi adapted the tour to our pace, considering that we were with seniors. We saw everything, and he explained curiosities and history in a very pleasant and attentive manner.
author: 308mireiag

title: Absolutely incredible experience!
text: Xavi was the best guide we've ever had. He knew everything about Gaudí and made the whole visit feel so personal. 10/10 would book again!
author: Cruiser690288

title: Amazing
text: What impressed me most was how unhurried everything felt despite covering so much ground. Xavi knew when to slow down, when to let silence do the work inside Sagrada Família, when to pick up the energy in the street. The man understands rhythm. So does Barcelona, honestly.
author: sofiabarruti

title: Don't miss it!
text: Super complete and flawless. I totally recommend
author: andr_sv295

title: Great option to visit Barcelona
text: Did both the basilica and old town tours and both were excellent! Same relaxed style and great storytelling.
author: g0nnm
